description: This file defines the PdfRealObject class, representing an indirect real number object within a PDF. It includes constructors, a 'Value' property, and methods for string representation and writing the object to a PDF stream.

classes.name: PdfRealObject
classes.description: Represents an indirect real value in a PDF document, inheriting from PdfNumberObject, and includes constructors, property, and methods related to PDF serialization.
